description: Pattern-based prevention rules for sentinel-bevy (NEURAL DEFENSE, Rust + Bevy) — regression detection from deep code review findings

rules.name: Rust: unwrap_or_else(panic!) in config/file loading
rules.message: unwrap_or_else(panic!) in file/config loading crashes the game on missing or malformed files. Return Result and handle gracefully.
rules.suggestion: Change the function to return Result<T, GameError> and propagate with ?. Show an error screen on failure instead of crashing.

rules.name: Rust: Placeholder asset reuse with 'for now' comment
rules.message: Placeholder asset reuse detected — 'for now' indicates a temporary shortcut that was never replaced. Track with a ticket or replace now.
rules.suggestion: Create a dedicated asset, or add a TODO(#issue) with a clear deadline for replacement.

rules.name: Rust: Relative file paths for config files
rules.message: Relative config file path resolves against CWD, not install dir. Use absolute paths from dirs crate.

rules.name: Rust: unwrap() in non-test Bevy code
rules.message: unwrap() can panic at runtime. Use expect() with a message or proper error propagation with ?.
rules.suggestion: Use .expect("descriptive message") or propagate the error with ?.

rules.name: Rust: panic!() in game setup / initialization
rules.message: panic!() in game initialization crashes on first run if any setup step fails. Use graceful error handling.
rules.suggestion: Return Result<(), GameSetupError> from setup functions and display an error state to the player.

rules.name: Rust: TODO/FIXME without tracking issue in asset or enemy code
rules.message: TODO/FIXME without ticket reference — placeholder code will be forgotten. Add a tracking issue.
rules.suggestion: Add ticket reference: TODO(#123) or FIXME(SENTINEL-456)
